findings.title: T12's string viewer prints the length of the line and the count of positions not listed in full, beyond 12 digits
findings.location:
site/src/components/tools/T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte:1003 ({view.length}) and :983 (
  • and {view.elided} more ...
    • ); site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts:535 asserts the unshortened text
findings.claim: The string viewer shortens the positions it lists but writes view.length and view.elided (bigint counts) as raw decimal text, so a value of 20 digits is shown in full.
findings.expected: SPEC 4.0 'Long numbers': 'A value of more than 12 digits is shown shortened ("1.2345... x 10^83", with the number of digits), with the exact digits in the table view, in the tooltip and in every export.' For /tools/rep/?g=A2&k=1&c=n&s=12345678901234567890,0 the length 12345678901234567891 should read '1.2345... x 10^19 (20 digits)' (the tool's own format), and so should the count 12345678901234567889 in the gap. The exact digits belong in a tooltip or data-value and in the export, which already has them (string.length).
findings.observed: data-out="string-length" text '12345678901234567891'; gap item 'and 12345678901234567889 more positions'. On the same line the positions are shortened ('1.2345... x 10^19 (20 digits)').
findings.reproduction: From a clean checkout of 006f50d plus commit e74421a: npm ci --prefer-offline && npm run build && RT03_PORT=5330 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<browsers> npx playwright test -c redteam/RT-03/playwright.config.ts redteam-RT-03-t12 -g "Long numbers" (fails: received {length: '12345678901234567891', gap: 'and 12345678901234567889 more positions'})
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 4.0 'Long numbers'; SPEC 4 T12 string viewer; precedent: P3-RT-03-03 (T5 dimension past 12 digits, major, confirmed and fixed)
findings.proposedFix: Render view.length and view.elided through the tool's shown()/shortValue when isLong, with the exact digits in a title (and a data-value for the hook). Update T12.spec.ts:535 to read the exact digits from that hook instead of the visible text. stringCaption in t12/rep.ts prints the same two values in full; no current route reaches it with a long value (M8's captions are the author's), but it should use the same helper.
findings.reproducer: site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-03-t12.spec.ts (test 'the length of a line of 12345678901234567891 positions, and the count of positions not listed')

notes: stringThrough has no bound on its length: it loops mu_i + 1 times, so stringThrough(A2, [2**40, 0], 0) would exhaust memory. E-6 says 'No function loops without a bound'. Here the output size is the contract's definition, and decisions/P5-A1.md logs the choice. T12 bounds it at 2000 positions and is not affected. For the owner, if E-6 is meant to cover input-sized outputs.

minusculeMatrices throws RangeError on cap 0, where SPEC 5.4 reads 'null when the orbit of omega_i has more than cap positions' (every orbit has more than 0). The choice is logged in decisions/P5-A1.md; the specification is silent on caps below 1.

T12 shows only the two ends of a line of at most 2000 positions whose entries pass 2^53 (for example s=(5, 9007199254740990) on A2: 6 positions, 2 listed, with 'Its entries pass 2^53, so only its two ends are computed here.'). The cause is the number[] contract of stringThrough. MERGE holds the request for a bigint stringThrough (DECISIONS.md, P5-A2 merge entry), so this is not reported.
Shared with RT-01 and RT-08 and not reported here: T12's 'Dimension' readout is the orbit size, also on nodes whose matrices are not built (E7 node 3 shows 2016, E8 node 1 2160).
